sentence: These sources name one radius and a 0.1-opacity shadow on everything, wide tracking on uppercase eyebrows, oversized hero text, a three-column icon grid, a stock section order and a "Get Started" gradient button [E99, E100, E101, E102, E105, E108].

evidence.quote: Border radius around half a rem on everything. Box shadows at roughly 0.1 opacity. A three-column feature grid with an icon per card.
Oversized hero text over vague copy.
Wide tracking on uppercase labels and eyebrow text was a deliberate stylistic choice years ago. Now it is auto-applied everywhere,
buttons, inputs, badges, and images all rounded to the same exaggerated radius. When every element has identical corners, hierarchy disappears and the layout reads as flat.
Stock section order. Hero, logos, three features, a testimonial, pricing, CTA - in that exact order, every time.
There is a gradient button that says "Get Started."
